4. testOrMatchesFirstTrue: first true -> matches true, ensure second not called.
5. testOrMatchesSecondTrue: first false, second true -> matches true.
6. testOrMatchesAllFalse: all false -> false.

7. testOrToString: verify comma separation.

8. testOrAddEvaluator: after add, matches uses new evaluator.

9. testRightMostEvaluatorAnd: after constructing And with multiple evaluators, rightMostEvaluator returns last.

Also test Or constructor with collection >1 wraps into And.
